english.title: Cause / use / permit registered trailer displaying incorrect registration mark
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who

(A)_[kept]_
(B)_[used]_

a trailer, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF TRAILER..),

(C)_[used it]_
(D)_[caused it to be used]_
(E)_[permitted it to be used]_

on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF ROAD..), with a plate fixed on it which displayed a mark that was

(F)_[not consistent with the specification of a registration mark in paragraph 1 of Schedule 2 to]_
(G)_[not assigned to it by the Secretary of State under regulation 15 of]_

the Trailer Registration Regulations 2018
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(3), 19(1)(h) and 25 of the Trailer Registration Regulations 2018.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a person who kept / used a trailer
used the trailer or caused / permitted the trailer to be used
on a road
with a plate fixed on the trailer which displayed a mark that was
not consistent with the specification of a registration mark in paragraph 1 of Schedule 2 to OR
not assigned to that trailer by the Secretary of State under regulation 15 of
the Trailer Registration Regulations 2018

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: £100 FPT can be issued for this offence from 28/03/19.
